definition: FREE = no MLB (all 30 clubs incl. Spring Training/postseason), no NFL (incl. preseason/postseason/Super Bowl), no Stanford/Cal NCAAF (incl. bowls/CFP), no Westwood One national NFL radio game on air. Westwood One games are a subset of NFL dates, so they never extend a busy block beyond the NFL block. Other Westwood One properties (NCAA basketball, golf, soccer, etc.) and other Bay Area sports radio (e.g. Warriors/Sharks) are OUTSIDE this core definition and listed as flagged additional risks.
strict_vs_practical: STRICT = all 30 MLB clubs incl. Spring Training count as busy. PRACTICAL = only Giants/Athletics/49ers/Stanford/Cal/Westwood One national count; other clubs' Spring Training ignored. The practical Feb window is the only 2-3+ week candidate.

practical.why: Extends to Opening Night Mar 25 if other clubs' Spring Training is ignored. Giants/A's Spring Training games would still occur in this span — check club schedules.

avg_durations_min.note: Research-based averages (see DUR-* sources). User-suggested 150/180 understates current averages; site uses researched values and shows the math. Add pregame/postgame buffer separately if desired.

daily_free_time_method.example: 1:05 PM PT NFL kickoff + 192 min = ~4:17 PM PT expected end (before OT/delays). 7:05 PM PT MLB first pitch + 170 min = ~9:55 PM PT expected end. Free = minutes outside all such blocks on that date.
